items.name: TONE_TILT_DB_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/tone.json at cab623a70753, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_tone_instance.h#span_db

items.doc: The tilt's span, dB: one first-order complementary shelf pair about pivotHz (omx_tilt, a = 10^(tiltDb/40)), -tiltDb/2 at DC, +tiltDb/2 at Nyquist and 0 dB at the pivot. Positive brightens, negative darkens; +6 is a +-3 dB pair, about 2 dB per octave at the pivot. 0 is flat, the come-up value, bit for bit. A wider reach is a wider travel here, never a second section.

items.name: TONE_PIVOT_HZ_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/tone.json at cab623a70753, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_tone_instance.h#pivot_hz

items.doc: The tilt's pivot, Hz: the frequency the tilt leaves at 0 dB, at every rate (the section is prewarped there).

items.name: TONE_FILTER_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/tone.json at cab623a70753, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_tone_instance.h#filter

items.doc: The DJ filter: below 0 a low-pass whose corner falls from TONE_FILTER_HIGH_HZ toward TONE_FILTER_LOW_HZ at -100, above 0 a high-pass whose corner rises from TONE_FILTER_LOW_HZ toward TONE_FILTER_HIGH_HZ at +100, on a log map; the EQ's own low-pass and high-pass sections. 0 is open, the come-up value, bit for bit.

items.name: TONE_RESONANCE_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/tone.json at cab623a70753, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_tone_instance.h#q

items.doc: The DJ filter's resonance, its section's Q: the magnitude at the corner. It comes up at 0.71, the Butterworth's 1/sqrt(2) on the step.

items.name: TONE_FILTER_LOW_HZ

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/tone.json at cab623a70753, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_tone_instance.h#OMX_TONE_INSTANCE_LOW_HZ

items.doc: The DJ filter's low end: the low-pass's corner at -100, and the high-pass's as the word leaves 0.

items.name: TONE_FILTER_HIGH_HZ

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/tone.json at cab623a70753, implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_tone_instance.h#OMX_TONE_INSTANCE_HIGH_HZ

items.doc: The DJ filter's high end: the high-pass's corner at +100, and the low-pass's as the word leaves 0; held at 0.999 of Nyquist where the rate is lower.
